purpose: External diversity/quality check of the archived paired10-step checkpoint with bounded geometry retries. This tests a speed/quality tradeoff against original and compact25, without changing prior raw failures.
panel: All48 frozen development families;16 eligible state families. No new targets or locked tests.
sampling: FP32 Euler10 CFG1 AE3 expanded conditioning for reflow10, original25CFG2 expanded and compact25CFG1 compact controls. K32 IID latent noise; decoder index0. Slot k uses latent k+32*a at attempt a=0..3; first geometry-valid accepted, exhausted slots return k. Seed2026100109, no reference-based selection. Preserve all raw/attempted outputs.
controls: All48 batch-versus-single controls require CA-RMSD<=0.2A and CA-lDDT>=0.99. Actual step count recorded and audited. Original and compact controls are reused only with exact source hashes, model identity and common native screen; selected original equality explicitly verified. New checkpoint external outputs have no same-weight prior ensemble; do not impose fictitious raw identity.
metrics: Unchanged ensemble_scoring_protocol.json; raw/selected quality, frozen2A coverage, both-state families, MD W1 and paired-family intervals. Include all failed/fallback outputs. Report both selected original and compact comparisons, retry cost and memory.
decision: External quality requires CA lower95% difference bound>-0.005, coarse-valid difference>=-0.01 and coverage difference>=0 versus selected original. Compact comparison is mandatory; passing original does not establish noninferiority to compact. If external quality passes, measure end-to-end latency with retries, ESM and direct-teacher comparison. K32 speed thresholds>=2x original and>=1.25x compact; no speed claim from generation-only times. No5/15/20-step, retry-cap, guidance or seed grid.
resources: One RTX15minute allocation/780second cap, cached ESM embeddings. Completion integrity audit and bounded CPU state scoring; <=8 own GPUs running+pending and15UTC deadline.
